title: Vault Credentials — Get
description: Fetch one stored credential's full body by id.

id.description: Local handle from a query descriptor. Opaque; consumers must not derive or guess one.

credential.description: The verifiable credential as stored, for a format whose canonical form is a JSON object. Carried verbatim. Mutually exclusive with `credentialBase64`.

credentialBase64.description: The credential's stored bytes, base64url-encoded without padding, for a format whose canonical form is not a JSON object: an SD-JWT's compact serialisation, an mdoc's CBOR. Mutually exclusive with `credential`.

format.description: The credential's format, as an OpenID for Verifiable Credentials format identifier (`ldp_vc`, `dc+sd-jwt`, `mso_mdoc`, `jwt_vc_json`), so the consumer reads the body without sniffing it.
